business_need.need_statement: The existing legacy core banking systems result in 48-hour customer onboarding delays, limiting retail market expansion.
business_need.why_now: Regulatory mandates for instant electronic KYC take effect in Q4 2026, posing compliance penalties.
business_need.who_feels_it: Retail banking applicants experience delays, while branch operations bear manual verification costs.
business_need.cost_of_inaction: Projected annual revenue loss of SAR 14.5M due to customer attrition to digital-first fintech competitors.

situation_analysis.current_state: Manual document intake and batch processing via legacy mainframe nodes averaging 48 hours per application.
situation_analysis.future_state_without_project: Onboarding times increase to 72 hours as application volumes grow by 30% year-on-year.
situation_analysis.root_causes: Lack of real-time API integrations with government identification registries.
situation_analysis.constraints_and_assumptions: Assumes regulatory API sandbox access remains stable through Q3 2026.

options_analysis.option_name: Option 1: Modernize with Microservices & Open Banking APIs
options_analysis.description: Deploy cloud-native API middleware connected to Saudi DGA and Wathq registers.
options_analysis.benefits: Reduces onboarding time to under 3 minutes; captures 25,000 additional accounts in year one.
options_analysis.costs: SAR 3.8M initial implementation plus SAR 450K annual recurring cloud subscriptions.
options_analysis.risks: Integration latency with legacy backend during Phase 1 rollout.
options_analysis.net_present_value: SAR 18.2M over 5-year investment period at 8% discount rate.

options_analysis.description: Maintain existing manual document verification teams and batch operations.
options_analysis.costs: Ongoing operational expenditure scaling at SAR 2.1M annually with overtime.
options_analysis.risks: Severe non-compliance fines and irreversible customer churn.

recommendation.recommended_option: Option 1: Modernize with Microservices & Open Banking APIs
recommendation.rationale: Delivers the highest NPV (SAR 18.2M), ensures full regulatory compliance before Q4 2026, and resolves customer pain points.
